benefits_features.Reward points benefits: Earn reward points for every Rs. 100 spent. Get 5X reward points for purchases made at partner stores including BookMyShow, Domino's, Yatra, Myntra, Netmeds and Apollo 24/7. 5X reward points on all other online spends.
benefits_features.Log-in Gift: On payment of annual fee of Rs.499 + applicable taxes, the card offers Amazon gift card worth Rs.500
benefits_features.Milestone rewards: Clear a trip vouchers worth Rs.3,000 each on your annual online spends of Rs.1 lakh & Rs.2 lakh.
benefits_features.Annual fee waiver: Spend Rs. 1 lakh on your SBI SimplyCLICK card and get your annual fee reversed in the subsequent year
benefits_features.Win and make payments: The card is embedded contactless technology allows you to make payments simply by waving at the card terminals.
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Receive a 5% fuel surcharge waiver on every fuel transaction between the amounts of Rs.500 and Rs.5,000, excluding other charges and GST.
benefits_features.Worldwide acceptance: The SimplyCLICK SBI Card is accepted internationally and can be used in more than 20 million outlets across the globe including 3.25 lakh outlets within India.
benefits_features.Add-on cards: Avail add-on cards for the members of your family who are above the age of 18.
benefits_features.Cash facility: Offers over 85,000 cash withdrawal access across the globe through Visa/Master Card
benefits_features.Utility Bill Payment: Offers the facility of utility bill payment using the Paytm Pay utility on your SimplyCLICK SBI Card for making payment for electricity bill, mobile telephone or other utility payments.
benefits_features.Balance transfer facility: Outstanding dues from other banks credit cards can be transferred to SBI SimplyCLICK Credit Card at a lower interest rate through the balance transfer facility.
benefits_features.Flexipay option: Any purchase above Rs.3,000 can be converted into EMI purchase with this Flexipay options.
benefits_features.Easy money facility: You can contact the SBI card customer care and order a bank draft at any time.

how_tos.How to Apply for SimplyCLICK SBI Card On:
Step 1: Go to bankbazaar.com and apply for the SBI Credit Card online.
Step 2: Go to the SBI bank and then choose the SimplyCLICK SBI Card tab.
Step 3: Click on the 'Check Eligibility' button to establish your eligibility for the card.
Step 4: If eligible, you will be redirected to the online application page.
Step 5: Fill in the entire application form and click on 'Submit'.
Step 6: Upload and submit the required documents in the following step.
Once your application is submitted, you’ll receive an acknowledgment message with the Application ID. You can use the same to track your credit card application status a week after submitting your application.

faqs.What are the advantages of the SBI Simpl: Those who frequently shop online can receive an additional rebate from the SBI SimplyCLICK credit card. If you frequently use services like Cleartrip, BookMyShow, Foodpanda, and others, you may benefit from this offer. This credit card offers two times more reward points than purchasing via other online and offline channels.
faqs.What is the difference between SBI Simpl: Most of the features and advantages of both credit cards are comparable. The key difference between the two is the interest charge on the outstanding balance. For instance, an SBI credit card's interest rate is 3.99 percent per month. On the other hand, for SimplyCLICK credit card, the rate of interest is 2.99% per month.
faqs.Which credit card is better, SBI SimplyC: SBI SimplyCLICK and SBI Card's credit cards have two distinct features. The SimplyCLICK credit card offers reward points for online purchasing, grocery stores, dining, etc. However, SBI credit card offers benefits on regular in-store expenditures like grocery stores, movie theatres, etc.
faqs.What are the various modes of payment of: There are various modes through which you can pay your SBI SimplyCLICK credit card online. Some of the modes are through debit card, Unified Payment Interface (UPI), National Electronic Fund Transfer (NEFT), net banking, mobile app, SBI Auto Debit, National Automated Clearing House (NACH), etc.
faqs.What are the mode of payment of SBI Simp: You can also pay your dues through different offline channels such as paying over the counter, cheque drop, mail drop box, Pre-printed electronic drop box and SBI Automated Teller Machine (ATM).
faqs.What should I do if I lose my SBI Simply: In the event of losing your SBI SimplyCLICK Credit Card, you must immediately contact your bank customer care by calling the bank's customer care line and requesting them to issue you a duplicate card. You can also visit the nearest branch of your bank and request your card to be blocked. Once that is done, you can request your bank to issue you a duplicate card.
faqs.What should I do if my credit card is bl: If you find that your credit card is getting blocked, don't panic. Make sure that you destroy the card by cutting it across the magnetic strip.
faqs.How can I track my Balance Transfer/Flex: There are two plans under processing for processing by SBI SimplyCLICK Credit Card. Firstly, your outstanding balance may be transferred to SBI SimplyCLICK Credit Card, with a processing fee of Rs. 199, whichever is higher, and an interest rate of 2.99% per month for a period of three months. The second plan has processing fee of Rs. 199, whichever is higher, and an interest rate of 12.75% per month for a six-month period.
faqs.Through which mode will the Balance Tran: Due to the impact made by the balance transfer payment, payment will be made directly through NEFT to your other bank credit card instead of cheque.
faqs.How many days will it take for my outsta: If you transfer your outstanding balance from Visa/MasterCard to the credit card, then it will take three working days for the transfer to happen. If your credit card is not a Visa/MasterCard, then the amount will be transferred within five working days.
faqs.How can I track Flexipay option?: You can avail the Flexipay option by logging into your SBI Card account online or under the SBI/64516P for calling by 990-020-1800, 020-1801,1290. If you are an NRI, the phone number varies.
faqs.What is the repayment period under the F: You can choose any one payment repayment periods under the Flexipay facility as per your convenience – six, nine, 12 and 24 months.
faqs.Are there any processing charges for boo: Yes, you will have to pay a processing fee of Rs.250 on amount converted to Flexipay subject to a minimum amount of Rs.250 and maximum amount of Rs.1,500 plus the taxes applicable.
faqs.How can I track my SBI SimplyCLICK Credi: You can track your SBI SimplyCLICK Credit Card application status by logging into their internet banking portal or calling SBI Credit Card customer care number.
faqs.What is the credit card currency transac: The card changes a currency transaction fee of 0.50% of the transaction amount.

How can I redeem the reward points on my: The reward points earned on your SBI SimplyCLICK credit card can be redeemed by either calling the customer service number or logging onto the net banking portal or mobile banking application.
